name: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech_synthesis/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_logmel_spectrogram: extract a log-mel spectrogram from a waveform tensor and optionally save it to a numpy file
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_pitch: extract pitch contour from a waveform using PyWORLD dio and stonemask with optional phoneme duration alignment
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_energy: extract energy features from a waveform using STFT magnitude and optionally align to phoneme durations
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_global_cmvn: compute global cepstral mean and variance normalization statistics from a directory of numpy feature files
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_mfa_alignment: get Montreal Forced Aligner phone-level alignment info from a TextGrid zip file for a list of sample IDs

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_waveforms_from_tts_model: run a fairseq TTS model to generate audio waveforms from text input and save as wav files
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.dump_tts_features: run the TTS generation script with --dump-features to save predicted mel-spectrogram features as numpy arrays
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.dump_tts_attentions: run the TTS generation script with --dump-attentions to save attention weight matrices for each sample
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.dump_tts_plots: run the TTS generation script with --dump-plots to generate alignment and output visualization PNG images
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.postprocess_tts_results: run postprocess_results to extract sample IDs, attention, EOS probabilities, features, and waveforms from generator hypotheses

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.compute_batch_mel_spectral_distortion: compute the mel spectral distortion between two batches of audio waveforms using log-mel spectrograms
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.compute_gross_pitch_error: compute the gross pitch error rate between ground truth and estimated F0 pitch contours
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.compute_f0_frame_error: compute the F0 frame error rate combining gross pitch errors and voicing decision errors
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.compute_voicing_decision_error: compute the voicing decision error rate between ground truth and estimated F0 pitch contours
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_pitch_evaluation_metrics: review the pitch evaluation metric functions for gross pitch error, F0 frame error, and voicing decision error
